what: Single-card dataloader tuning sweep for a YOLOX-L detection training run. Seven configurations, one card, 240 s of steady state each, warmup discarded.

provenance.hardware: one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, 32607 MiB, in an eight-card node
provenance.workload: YOLOX-L, mmdetection, --amp, images/s measured from the training log
provenance.window: 240 s of steady state per configuration, first 25% of logged steps discarded as warmup
provenance.note: One run per cell. That is the honest limit of this sweep and every conclusion below is written to survive it -- see `sweeprank rank --resolution`.

throughput_img_s.note: The quantity the sweep exists to maximise. Derived as batch/step_time from the training log, not from any counter.

sm_util_mean_pct.note: nvidia-smi dmon SM%, mean over the steady-state window. The sweep's stated goal was written on this metric.

power_mean_w.note: A cost may report and may veto; it may never select.

data_time_frac_pct.note: Fraction of the step spent waiting on the dataloader. Explains; never selects.

declared_goal.quoted_from: the sweep's own header line: target SM utilisation >= 70%, baseline batch 8 / workers 8 / pin False -> SM 61.4%, 70.74 img/s

configs.failed: CUDA out of memory: tried to allocate 158.00 MiB with 115.56 MiB free of 31.36 GiB
